key_concepts: Percent by mass/volume equals mass of solute divided by total solution volume times 100
Percent by volume/volume equals volume of solute divided by total solution volume times 10
Mass of solution equals mass of solute plus mass of solvent
Volume of solution equals volume of solute plus volume of solvent
Use percent mass/volume for solid solute in liquid solvent
Use percent volume/volume for liquid-liquid or gas-gas solutions
To find solute mass, multiply percent concentration as a decimal by solution volume
To find solute volume, multiply percent concentration as a decimal by solution volume
A 10% sugar solution by mass contains 10 g sugar in 100 mL solution
A 12% alcohol by volume in 355 mL wine contains 42.6 mL alcohol
Aqueous means the solvent is water; brine means the solute is sodium chloride
Word indicators such as 'dissolve in' and 'by dissolving' help identify solvent and solute
